name: mateon-app
description: MATE:ON mobile app for living better together

scripts.test: node test-score.js && node test-smoke.js && node test-lifetools.js && node test-sw.js && node scripts/test-qr.js
scripts.export:svg: node scripts/export-faithful-svg.mjs && node scripts/assemble-svg-deliverables.mjs && node scripts/build-svg-review.mjs
scripts.android: npm run build && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && cap sync android && node scripts/build-android.js
scripts.android:release: npm run build && cap sync android && node scripts/build-android.js bundleRelease && node scripts/verify-aab.js android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run size && npm run build && node scripts/release-check.js --strict
